- Conhecimento em scripts (ex.: PowerShell, Bash, Python) para automação e ferramentas operacionais.

- Sólido conhecimento em Windows e Unix/Linux, incluindo troubleshooting, performance e aplicação de patches.

- Experiência com suporte a aplicações e middleware (ex.: servidores web/app, agendamento batch, transferência de arquivos).

- Experiência com ferramentas/tecnologias corporativas como SQL Server, Oracle, Control-M, MQ, ServiceNow, Splunk, Jira, Nexus, LDAP/AD.

- Conhecimento prático em gestão de certificados (inventário, planejamento de renovação/rotação, implantação e validação pós-mudança).

- Entendimento de conceitos de CI/CD e workflows baseados em Git / pipelines de deploy.

- Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders;
capacidade de trabalharcom fornecedores globais/locais e equipes internas.

- Inglês avançado.

Desejável:

- Experiência com SAFe;
exposição ao GCP.

- Experiência com iniciativas de migração/modernização.

- Espanhol.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Devops Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer with basic Golang skills to support a team focused on improving development processes and the product. In this role, you will work closely with a Staff Engineer building with a focus on designing, migrating, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and cloud environments that enable these systems to operate reliably and at scale.

Your work will involve containerized services, AWS Lambda, Terraform-managed infrastructure, and secure data transfer between AWS accounts, with a strong emphasis on scalability, security, and operational excellence.

You will collaborate with engineering, product, and operational teams, while also coordinating technical requirements with the vendor. Strong communication skills are important, as you'll often act as the bridge between the team and other internal teams, ensuring infrastructure and systems are aligned with internal standards and best practices.

What we're looking for:

● Strong AWS and DevOps experience (infrastructure, deployments, operations, observability)

● Solid experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred)

● Experience with containerized environments (Docker, ECS/EKS, etc.)

● Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Lambda and related cloud tooling

● Golang and Bash skills for scripting, automation, and backend support

● Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple stakeholders

● Strong communication and coordination skills

Nice to have:

● Familiarity with TypeScript or Node.Js

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy working towards engineering excellence and helping the team excel. You will collaborate across infrastructure and development teams to deliver impactful solutions.

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Onboarding Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.

We're expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Onboarding Specialist. You will own the customers' first 30 - 45 days, set the tone for the relationship, build confidence and ensure customers are ready quickly and correctly. This role defines the customer's first impression of Smarter Contact and has clear growth potential within a fast-scaling SaaS company. This is a direct-hire role.

What You'll Own:

  • Lead and follow up on all 1-1 or group onboarding sessions via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Guide customers through initial setup, configuration, and first live campaigns
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact's value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Ensure customers reach defined activation milestones within the onboarding window
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or risk during onboarding-escalate and resolve
  • Document onboarding outcomes, next steps, and handoff notes clearly in CRM
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience to ensure a clean transition post onboarding.
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday

What We're Looking For:

  • 4+ years in Customer Success, Onboarding or Implementation at a SaaS company
  • Experience with US-based customers
  • Excellent communication and conversational skills, both written and verbal
  • Proficient or native level English (full business fluency)
  • Detail-oriented, process-driven, and highly organized
  • Engaging, personable, and energetic in customer interactions
  • Comfortable working at high volume without losing quality
  • Sales-trained and able to identify business expansion opportunities
  • Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player,
  • Proven track record of meeting and/or exceeding a business expansion quota

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working at a telecom SaaS
  • Experience working with real estate agents or using real estate SaaS tools

️ Why Smarter Contact?

  • USD base compensation
  • 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays
  • High autonomy, fast execution, real impact
  • Professional development benefit
  • Wellness benefit
  • Employment anniversary and birthday gift
  • Quarterly health allowance
  • Remote-first team with a strong performance culture
  • This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor role

Please Don't Apply If:

  • You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment
  • You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams
  • You don't meet the minimum customer success experience
  • No experience working for a SaaS company

Ready to grow with us?

We're looking for a proven Customer Onboarding Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Loyalty Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Loyalty Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?

About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Loyalty Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you'll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.

What You'll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You'll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured "silent churn" playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years in a customer retention or account management role.
  • 3+ years within a SaaS company.
  • Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet.
  • Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts.
  • Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure.
  • Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies.
  • Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality.
  • Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value.
  • Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player.
  • Proficient or native level English (full business fluency).
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company.
  • Experience working with real estate professionals.

️ Why Smarter Contact?

  • USD base compensation
  • 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off)
  • High autonomy, fast execution, real impact
  • Professional development benefit
  • Wellness benefit
  • Employment anniversary and birthday gift
  • Quarterly health allowance
  • Remote-first team with a strong performance culture
  • This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor role

Please Don't Apply If:

  • You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment
  • You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams
  • You don't meet the minimum customer success experience
  • No experience working for a SaaS company

Ready to grow with us?

We're looking for a proven Customer Loyalty Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Loyalty Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Loyalty Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market.We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Loyalty Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you'll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.What You'll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. You'll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI. Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines. Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured "silent churn" playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.What We're Looking For: 5+ years in a customer retention or account management role. 3+ years within a SaaS company. Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet. Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts. Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure. Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies. Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality. Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value. Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player. Proficient or native level English (full business fluency). Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday. Bonus Points: Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company. Experience working with real estate professionals.️ Why Smarter Contact? USD base compensation 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off) High autonomy, fast execution, real impact Professional development benefit Wellness benefit Employment anniversary and birthday gift Quarterly health allowance Remote-first team with a strong performance culture This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor rolePlease Don't Apply If: You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams You don't meet the minimum customer success experience No experience working for a SaaS companyReady to grow with us? We're looking for a proven Customer Loyalty Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Supply Chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Business Analyst - Supply Chain em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.

Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain, a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

- Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

- Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

- Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

- Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

- Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.

Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

- Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

- Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

- Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

- Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

- Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

- Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

- Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

- Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.

Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

- Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

- Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

- Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.

Must Have

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

- Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

- Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

- Availability to travel.

- Legally authorized to work in Brazil.

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

- A collaborative and international work environment.

- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.

Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant - Family Owned Business Group
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Virtual Executive Assistant - Family Owned Business Group em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production.

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts. We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries, gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison, screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials, agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers, including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects, including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency, with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio, not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend / Product Engineering)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Backend / Product Engineering) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer (Backend / Product Engineering)

Location: Brazil (100% remote)

Contract: PJ – Long Term

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a high-impact team focused on building and scaling systems that power pricing, payments, and merchandising within a luxury resale marketplace. This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering and product development, supporting both customer-facing applications and internal tools used by operators and business teams.

You will collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineering leadership to deliver reliable, scalable, and high-performing systems that directly influence key business initiatives.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and internal tooling
  • Contribute to user-facing applications that support listing, enrichment, and merchandising workflows
  • Write clean, performant, and testable code in a production environment
  • Participate in architectural decisions and help shape the future of the platform
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, and engineering stakeholders
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to peers
  • Pair program and support team collaboration and onboarding
  • Deploy code to production with a strong focus on reliability and quality
  • Leverage observability tools, metrics, and incident learnings to improve system performance and stability

Tech Stack

Java, Kotlin, Elixir, Ruby, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS (Lambda), PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Experience building production-ready, scalable, and secure systems
  • Solid understanding of backend development and modern web applications
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, and common development tools
  • Experience or interest in JVM-based services (Java/Kotlin)
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures and streaming systems (e.G., Kafka)
  • Knowledge of database fundamentals and API design (GraphQL or similar)
  • Passion for testing, code quality, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to contribute to technical direction and architectural decisions
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with JVM services in production environments
  • Experience with modern frontend technologies (React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS)
  • Experience integrating LLMs or AI APIs into applications or internal tools
  • Experience building microservices and working across distributed systems
  • Background in eCommerce platforms
  • Familiarity with CMS platforms (e.G., Prismic)
  • Experience with monitoring, dashboards, and incident response

Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Talent Acquisition Specialist About Us: We are a dynamic global specialist in talent research, intelligence, and pipelining. Since its founding in 2011, it's grown to serve internal talent acquisition teams—including more than 70 Fortune 500 companies —through offices spanning the UK, US, India, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, and beyond. We blend data-driven insight and proactive sourcing to streamline recruitment, delivering seamless access to ready now candidates and curated pipelines for future roles. Its recent acquisition of Armstrong Craven further strengthens our global reach and research capabilities, offering clients unmatched flexibility and depth in talent solutionsThe Role: We have partnered with a global FMCG powerhouse which has a reputation for innovation and development. As part of this contract we are looking for a passionate Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist. If you're excited by new challenges, solving complex problems, and learning every step of the way, you might be the perfect fit. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to drive impactful projects and collaborate with bright minds.What You'll Do: Manage autonomously the different talent acquisition solutions to source, engage, attract, and secure the right talent for the organization within a highly scientific environment Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, execute effective sourcing, engagement, screening, and behavioural-based interviews that deliver a diverse range of candidates and provide an outstanding candidate experience Possess strong ability to screen, assess, interview, and build relationships within different talent communities in a timely and professional manner Build and maintain market intelligence and a network of talent and potential candidates through previous experience, pro-active research, and ongoing relationships;
conduct in-depth interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate manager requirements through high interview-to-offer ratios Display confidence to work with metrics and reporting to establish recruitment updates and insight to ensure hiring is effective and can clearly demonstrate successes versus areas of focus Generate and recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the enhancement of hiring processes, implementing changes and new procedures, and fine-tuning standard recruiting processes that fit within the client's mission Contribute to or lead projects designed to implement change initiatives and enhance delivery Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines, formal tracking, and reporting results Promote continuous improvement of talent acquisition methods and processesWhat we are looking for: Passion for talent acquisition with an extensive track record of recruiting hard to fill roles Expert understanding of talent networks and recruitment landscapes in Brazil and South America Ability to execute sourcing activities, including but not limited to employer brand promotion, talent engagement and attraction, supporting events and meet-ups, and quality candidate pipeline generation with a significant proportion of direct and passive sourcingWho You Are: Someone who is not satisfied with "just good enough" and is always looking to improve, adapt, and innovate A natural collaborator who loves sharing ideas and learning from others Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, able to share complex ideas in a simple, relatable way Fluent in English and PortugueseAre You Still Curious? If you've read this far, then chances are you've got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can't wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of the client.

title: Engenheiro De Dados Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Dados Sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!

O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership, tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi, com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance;
  • Lidar com dadosdistribuídos em múltiplos silos, conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros, incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS, especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC);
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup, lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Modelo remoto prioritário
  • Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
  • R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
  • R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação
  • 30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano
  • Day off no aniversário
  • TotalPass (incluindo TotalMind)
  • Acesso ao Wework
  • Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo

title: Médico Oncologista Genético
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Oncologista Genético em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\ "

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Oncologia Genética! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.

*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.
  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.

Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Oncologista.

title: Senior Backend Developer Kyc
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Developer Kyc em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we're not just building products, we're pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world's most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that's just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you're passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We've grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a senior Backend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the backend components of multiple services related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
  • Scalability - all backend services that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Backend Development team is responsible for building all the API services and backend processes with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with developers, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, practical architectures.
  • Improve existing core backend services written in NodeJS
  • Implement new solutions that interact with different core services through RPC calls
  • Write complex database queries for compliance and financial purposes

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience working with Javascript/Nodejs.
  • Familiar with microservices architecture
  • Have actively participated in the development of a complex platform
  • Good experience in interacting with databases (MySQL, MongoDB)
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies
  • Good understanding of security practices

Preferred skills

  • Experience with blockchain integration
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts
  • Ruby and Rails experience
  • Other technologies of interest: Message queues (Redis), Caches and Job Queues

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter's identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you're unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.To or @tether.Io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Engenheiro De Dados Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Dados Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!

O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership, tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi, com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance;
  • Lidar com dadosdistribuídos em múltiplos silos, conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros, incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS, especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC);
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup, lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Modelo remoto prioritário
  • Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
  • R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
  • R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação
  • 30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano
  • Day off no aniversário
  • TotalPass (incluindo TotalMind)
  • Acesso ao Wework
  • Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Frontend Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital FinanceAt Tether, we're not just building products, we're pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.Innovate with Tether Tether Finance:Our innovative product suite features the world's most trusted stablecoin,USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that's just the beginning: Tether Power:Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data:Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions likeKEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you're passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We've grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future?About the job As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes: New Products and Features- Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry. Performance- all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth. Security- Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.Responsibilities Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including: New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies. Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth. Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools. Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.Requirements With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend. Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture. Comfortable with high-availability concepts. Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+. Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these. Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools. Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs. Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life. Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications.Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels.We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: Verify the recruiter's identity.All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you're unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods.We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses.All communication from us will come from emails ending   @tether.Io We will never request payment or financial details.If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Médico Oncologista Genético
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Oncologista Genético em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. *OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\ " Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas emOncologia Genética!Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOSFormação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE(Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);
Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.Local de Trabalho: REMOTORemuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.IMPORTANTE:MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Oncologista.

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior
description:

Estamos em busca de um perfil com sólida trajetória técnica para atuar na ponte entre sistemas robustos e arquiteturas modernas. Se você domina o ecossistema Java e tem experiência com Microfrontends, essa vaga é para você!

O que buscamos:

  • Formação: Graduação completa em TI.
  • Experiência: +7 anos com Java (EJB, JPA) e APIs REST.
  • Front-end: +2 anos com Angular (2+) e vivência prática com Microfrontend.
  • Mensageria: Domínio de Kafka e filas JMS.
  • DevOps/Ferramentas: Maven, Bitbucket, Sonar e Swagger.
  • Servidores: Conhecimento em Websphere, JBoss ou Wildfly.
  • Banco de Dados: Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL.

Diferenciais que valorizamos:

  • Spring Boot e Flutter.
  • Banco de dados DB2.
  • Expertise em Stored Procedures e Performance Tuning.

Cultura e Metodologia:

  • Atuação com Scrum/Kanban (Jira).
  • Foco total em Clean Code e Design Patterns.
  • Perfil resolutivo e facilidade em trabalhar em equipe.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Supply Chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Business Analyst - Supply Chain em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who We AreWe are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation. Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.Who We Are Looking For We are currently seeking aSenior Business Analyst – Supply Chain, a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution). This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts. If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.Key Responsibilities Business Requirements & Client Engagement
- Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.
- Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.
- Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.
- Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

title: Senior Outsystems Engineer
description:

Senior OutSystems Engineer

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior OutSystems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom-built solution.

This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance.

What You'll Do

Stabilize and Modernize Architecture

Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies

Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability

Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows

Optimize Database and System Performance

Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies

Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database

Replace inefficient polling with event-driven or conditional patterns

Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance

Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability

Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues

Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations

Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health

Build a Real Release Pipeline

Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline

Configure deployment automation using OutSystems APIs

Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls

Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing

Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing

Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities

Remove unused or redundant components

Define governance for capacity-impacting changes

Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality

Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform

Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes

Map data entities into portable schemas

Capture business logic embedded within the platform

Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components

Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows

What You Bring

Required Experience

5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale OutSystems applications

Deep experience with OutSystems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API

Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements

Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures

Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing

Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within OutSystems

Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting or leading OutSystems to custom platform migrations

Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows

Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling

Experience with license optimization and application object management

Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems

Working Environment

Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership

Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions

Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations

Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users

This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.

title: Especialista De Machine Learning I
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista De Machine Learning I em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsabilidades e atribuições Atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de plataformas e componentes reutilizáveis para o ciclo de vida de modelos de Machine Learning. Construir e manter pipelines de MLOps para automação de etapas como treino, validação, empacotamento, versionamento, deploy, rollback, monitoramento e retreinamento de modelos. Apoiar a produção de modelos de Machine Learning em ambientes batch, near real-time e real-time, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência, segurança e observabilidade. Desenvolver frameworks, aceleradores, templates e padrões técnicos que facilitem o desenvolvimento e a implantação de modelos por diferentes times. Atuar na integração entre modelos de ML, pipelines de dados, APIs, microsserviços, feature stores, serviços de inferência e plataformas cloud. Definir e implementar boas práticas de CI/CD para Machine Learning, incluindo testes automatizados, validação de dados, validação de modelos, quality gates e estratégias de promoção entre ambientes. Contribuir para a criação de padrões de observabilidade para modelos em produção, incluindo métricas técnicas e de negócio, drift de dados e de modelos, latência, disponibilidade, custo e performance. Atuar em parceria com times de Data Science, Dados, Engenharia, Arquitetura, Segurança e Governança para garantir aderência a padrões corporativos, regulatórios e operacionais. Participar de discussões técnicas e arquiteturais sobre o uso de Machine Learning em contextos críticos do negócio financeiro.Requisitos e qualificaçõesFormação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Machine Learning, MLOps, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia de Dados ou áreas correlatas. Conhecimento prático do ciclo de vida de modelos de Machine Learning em produção: desenvolvimento, treino, versionamento, deploy, monitoramento, sustentação e melhoria contínua. Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python, Java e boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo testes, versionamento, code review, modularização e documentação técnica. Conhecimento em construção e orquestração de pipelines de dados e/ou ML, utilizando ferramentas como Airflow, Step Functions, Kubeflow, MLflow, Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou equivalentes. Experiência com cloud computing, preferencialmente AWS, incluindo serviços relacionados a processamento, armazenamento, orquestração, APIs, segurança e observabilidade. Conhecimento em containers, APIs, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída, como Docker, Kubernetes, serviços REST/gRPC ou equivalentes. Experiência com práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a modelos, serviços de inferência ou pipelines analíticos. Conhecimento em bancos de dados, SQL, ambientes analíticos e integração com plataformas de dados. Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de Data Science e negócio em soluções técnicas reutilizáveis, escaláveis e sustentáveis. Experiência com monitoramento, logs, métricas, rastreabilidade e troubleshooting de aplicações, pipelines ou modelos em produção. Experiência com plataformas de model registry, feature store, experiment tracking, model serving e model monitoring, utilizando ferramentas como MLflow, SageMaker, Databricks, Feast, Evidently, WhyLabs, BentoML, KServe ou similares. Conhecimento em arquitetura de plataformas internas para Machine Learning, com foco em self-service, padronização e reuso. Experiência com modelos em ambientes de alta escala, alta disponibilidade ou baixa latência. Conhecimento em governança de modelos, explicabilidade, documentação, auditoria, gestão de risco, qualidade de dados e compliance.Informações adicionais Para se destacar nesta posição seria legal se você também tivesse:Conhecimento em LLMOps, RAG, agentes de IA, gateways de LLMs, avaliação de respostas, controle de custos e observabilidade para IA generativa. Experiência com frameworks de IA generativa e integração com LLMs, como LangChain, LangGraph, Spring AI, Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI ou equivalentes. Experiência em ambientes regulados, especialmente mercado financeiro, meios de pagamento, bancos digitais, fintechs, crédito, risco, fraude, adquirência ou CRM. Conhecimento em Kafka, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e processamento distribuído. Experiência com práticas de segurança em cloud, IAM, secrets management, criptografia, segregação de ambientes e proteção de dados sensíveis. Familiaridade com LGPD, princípios de Responsible AI e governança de dados.

Confira esta oportunidade para Operations & Project Manager | Lifesupplyusa | Remote em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Operations & Project Manager | LifeSupplyUSA | Remote | Latin America

How to Apply

We do not accept applications through LinkedIn.

To be considered, please record a short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself, describing a project or process you have owned end-to-end, and explaining why this role is the right next step for you. Applications without a Loom will not be reviewed. Send your video link and resume to .

About Us

LifeSupplyUSA is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce retailers of household essentials in the United States, specializing in air filters, HVAC filters, extension cords, and home goods. We operate across Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, and additional marketplaces with a lean, high-performance remote team. We are scaling fast and hiring the person who will keep the entire operation running like a machine.

The Role

We are hiring an Operations & Project Manager to serve as the execution backbone of the business and the primary management layer between our COO and our team.

This is not a coordinator role. This is a real management position with real authority.

You will own our operational rhythm, enforce accountability across every function, resolve blockers before they become problems, and ensure the entire team executes with precision, without the COO needing to be involved in day-to-day issues.

If things fall through the cracks, it is your job to catch them before anyone else notices.

Remote | Growth path to COO

What You Will Own

ClickUp Environment Own the ClickUp workspace as the single source of truth for all work in progress. Enforce task hygiene daily. Audit weekly. Onboard new team members to standards.

Deadline Tracking & Escalation Monitor all active tasks and projects for deadline risk proactively. Maintain a weekly at-risk task list. Surface root cause analysis to the COO when patterns emerge.

Meeting Cadence Ownership Own all recurring meetings end to end: Daily Standup, Weekly 1:1s, COO Operations Review, Project Kickoffs, and Monthly Ops Review. Agendas distributed 24 hours in advance. Notes and action items distributed within 24 hours of each meeting.

Cross-Team Coordination & Blocker Resolution Serve as the coordination layer between all functions. No team member should be stuck on a blocker for more than 24 hours without a resolution plan.

Workload & Priority Management Monitor workload distribution across the team. Surface imbalances to the COO with recommended reallocation before output is affected.

KPI Dashboard Management Own the weekly KPI reporting cycle. Compile and present the consolidated dashboard to the COO weekly. Flag all missed KPIs immediately with root cause and action plan.

Operational SOP Library Own the company's full SOP library. Every recurring operational workflow documented and current.

Team Accountability Hold every team member directly accountable for tasks, deadlines, and ClickUp hygiene, without involving the COO in routine accountability conversations.

Your KPI Scorecard

ClickUp Task Hygiene (owner + due date + status): 98%+ Deadline Adherence Rate: 90%+ Overdue Task Rate: 5% or less Meeting Agenda Coverage: 100% KPI Dashboard Timeliness: 100% SOP Coverage: 100%

What You Will Need

Proven experience in operations management or project management in a fast-paced remote environment Strong hands-on experience with ClickUp (required) or equivalent PM tools (Monday.Com, Asana, Notion) Experience managing or coordinating a distributed, cross-functional team Exceptional organizational skills with a bias toward action, clarity, and follow-through Ability to make independent judgment calls and resolve issues without constant escalation Excellent written and spoken English Experience building and maintaining SOPs and operational documentation E-commerce or operations background is a strong plus Self-motivated, highly organized, and committed to a single full-time role

Your Authority

You will have real, day-to-day management authority to:

  • Reprioritize tasks and reassign workload across the team
  • Hold team members accountable for missed deadlines
  • Resolve cross-team blockers and coordination conflicts
  • Give direct feedback on execution standards
  • Make judgment calls on task sequencing and urgency
  • Approve minor process changes that do not affect KPIs or strategy

Growth Path

Operations & Project Manager → Senior Operations Manager → Chief Operating Officer

The growth path is real. Phase 1 is about building credibility through execution discipline and demonstrating the judgment to manage independently.

What We Offer

Competitive base salary plus performance bonuses 100% remote Paid time off Clear, defined path to COO Real management authority from day one A lean, high-performance team that values direct communication and results

Important Notes

No freelancers or part-time applicants Gross salary — candidate handles own taxes Full commitment required: no other clients or roles

How to Apply

We do not accept applications through LinkedIn.

To be considered, please record a short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself, describing a project or process you have owned end-to-end, and explaining why this role is the right next step for you. Applications without a Loom will not be reviewed. Send your video link and resume to .

We are moving quickly. Strong candidates will hear back fast.

title: Analista De Implantação Erp - Módulo Fiscal/Contábil

Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento. Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança. Eficácia:Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido. Entusiasmo:Acreditamos que o entusiasmo e a positividade são essenciais para o sucesso. Quem ama o que faz trabalha com alegria e aproveita a jornada. Evolução:Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.
